mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating labor market strength) and low UNRATE (< 4%) creates a virtuous cycle, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with declining INDPRO, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $500M in a month indicates increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low FEDFUNDS (< 0.5%) maintains accommodative monetary conditions, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between high PAYEMS growth (> 2% in 1 month) and low UNRATE (< 5%) indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth exceeding 10% in 2 months signals increased housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances with high HOUST growth during early-cycle expansions, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
